conceptZh: 一隻造型亮麗的風條機械玩具魚從水桶躍出，因發條扭過頭在空中搞笑停格，魚頭化為頂部「⺈」，矩形魚身格子展開為中間「田」，底下彈出的四滴圓潤水花定格為底部「灬」，完美組合成繁體「魚」字。
object: a bright teal mechanical wind-up toy fish with friendly large cartoon eyes
morph: the toy fish's head shapes into the top slanted roof strokes, its rectangular body grid unfolds into the middle square field grid, and four round water droplets beneath lock into the bottom four dots
creativeAngle: 以發條玩具魚彈跳過頭的趣味意外（wind-up mishap）作為喜劇開端，將繁體「魚」字結構拆解為「魚頭（⺈）、魚身（田）、水花尾巴（灬）」，既有鮮明物件連結，又具備流暢幽默的視覺轉折。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D animation featuring a playful mechanical wind-up toy fish on a clean, soft pastel cream studio background. At 0-2 seconds, the bright teal toy fish with friendly oversized cartoon eyes pops out of a small toy bucket. As it reaches the top of its leap, its internal wind-up key gives a funny cartoon boing, causing the fish to freeze mid-air with wide, comic surprise eyes. From 2-5 seconds, the toy fish gracefully morphs into the single exact Traditional Chinese character 魚: its pointed head folds into the top roof strokes, its rectangular body grid opens into the middle square grid, and four glossy water droplets beneath it snap into the bottom four dots. The character strokes are rendered in a saturated deep navy blue against the bright cream background. From 5 to 8 seconds, the finished glyph stays perfectly centered, filling approximately 70% of frame height with ample margins, holding completely static and crisp without clutter or on-screen text. Audio features a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaking in clear Taiwanese Mandarin: "魚、魚、金魚", perfectly timed across the clip. No subtitles or extra text appear on screen.

conceptZh: 胖桶玩具海盜請鸚鵡幫忙壓魚形印章，鸚鵡偏偏不動。海盜改用肚子猛壓，印章輕輕回彈，把他彈成坐姿，留下清楚的「魚」。
object: One oversized fish-shaped toy stamp with a spring-loaded back and a concealed, correctly carved 魚 printing face.
morph: No stroke morphing: a single belly press prints the complete, correctly formed 魚. The stamp lifts away to reveal the upper head strokes, central 田 structure, and four distinct bottom dots simultaneously.
creativeAngle: 改用肚子蓋章的失衡笑點，取代魚跳出水桶再變字。鸚鵡抱翅拒絕幫忙，海盜只好親自出馬；預製完整字模一次印出正確筆畫，避免變形過程造成字形混淆。
promptEn:
Create an 8-second stylized 3D animated miniature on a light apricot tabletop, viewed by a locked overhead camera. The original lead is a barrel-shaped wooden toy pirate with stubby articulated limbs, a plain plum felt hat, and comically excessive confidence. His small turquoise cartoon parrot is stubbornly unimpressed. Their only additional prop is an oversized fish-shaped toy stamp, centered and entirely within frame. Its rounded head, rectangular body, and four small underside fin details visually suggest the head, central grid, and four bottom dots of 魚. Its concealed printing face uses an accurately formed Traditional Chinese type master, never a decorative approximation.

At 0.0–1.1 seconds, the pirate grandly gestures for the parrot to press the stamp's spring-loaded back. The parrot folds its wings and deliberately looks away. After a brief expectant pause, the pirate puffs up with determination. From 1.1–2.8 seconds, he climbs belly-first onto the stamp and wiggles his tiny feet, struggling to compress it. At 2.8 seconds his round belly finally pushes it down with a soft rubber squeak. The gentle spring return tips him backward into a seated position beside the stamp; his hat slips over his eyes. The parrot remains perfectly deadpan. Keep this one physical payoff clear and unhurried.

From 3.3–4.4 seconds, the pirate peeks beneath his hat, discovers his success, and proudly lifts and slides the stamp out through the lower edge. The parrot rides away on his hat. Reveal one crisp, saturated dark-blue 魚 printed on the pale tabletop. The upper strokes, central 田, and four separate bottom dots must be correct, balanced, and unobstructed. From 4.4–8.0 seconds, hold the finished glyph completely still, centered and uncropped, filling approximately 70% of frame height with comfortable margins. All cast and props have cleared the composition. Use soft matte materials, bright gentle lighting, and no flashing effects.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly "魚、魚、金魚". Speak the first 魚 at 4.5 seconds, the second at 5.4 seconds, and 金魚 at 6.5–7.3 seconds, with natural pauses. The finished glyph remains clearly visible throughout the spoken line. Stop after 金魚. Keep the spring squeak soft and before narration; use no music or other speech. The single printed 魚 is the only visible text anywhere: no vocabulary lettering, subtitles, logos, or watermark.
